value_conventions.weight: Relative selection weight. The default weights total 1.0.
value_conventions.amount: Meaning depends on type: the stat delta, the item rolls, or the Aegis count.
value_conventions.format: How amount is rendered: number, percent, or absolute_percent.

supported_types.custom_stat: Adds amount to the player custom stat named by stat. Set attributed to credit the talent in the stat breakdown.
supported_types.random_aegis: Grants amount random enabled, unowned Aegises.
supported_types.random_item: Independently rolls amount random enabled registered item types.
supported_types.charge_grant: Grants min to max charges of the kind named by charge: skill_enhancement, perk, perk_refresh, or aegis.
supported_types.spawn_hostile: Spawns entity, hostile to the player, with the given attribute overrides.
supported_types.health_strike: Above threshold Health multiplies current Health by multiplier_above, otherwise sets it to fallback_health; lightning optionally follows.

negation.negated_by_law_of_cycle: When true, Law of Cycle cancels this outcome.
negation.negated_conversion: How Madoka with Homura repays a negated outcome: percentage, damage_reduction, or nonnumeric.
